verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 4.0 'Long numbers' (under the heading '4.0 Rules common to every tool [D]'): 'A value of more than 12 digits is shown shortened ("1.2345... x 10^83", with the number of digits), with the exact digits in the table view, in the tooltip and in every export.' The sentence supports the finding's expected. SPEC 4 T12 heading: 'T12. Representation Builder (phase 5)'. SPEC 6.6 Validation accepts a start entry of up to 40 digits.
verdicts.evidence:
I read everything at gate commit 006f50d (worktree detached there; git status --porcelain empty; no node_modules, no dist, no server). The 4.0 sentence has no qualifier: no 'may', no 'where the layout allows', and nothing limits it to values on nodes. The [D] mark sits on the 4.0 heading, and the build departs from the [D] text rather than choosing within it. 6.6 Validation: 'a start with an entry longer than 40 digits' makes a link invalid, so s=12345678901234567890,0 (20 digits) is a valid link. The T12 text 'The viewer accepts any position' makes the input reachable through the tool. T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte at the gate commit prints both counts raw: '{view.length}' and '
  • and {view.elided} more ...
    • '. The positions on the same line use positionShown, and their title is set only when isLong. t12/rep.ts lineView: length = reach + 1n; when tooLong, elided = length - 2n. Both counts are bigints with no bound below 40 digits. The builders' test site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts:535 asserts the full text String(BigInt(big) + 1n). The reproducer, read as text from worktree-agent-a1a223038b02fb4cf, asserts the length '1.2345... x 10^19 (20 digits)' and a gap containing 'x 10^19 (20 digits)'. Records: decisions/P5-A2.md 'the string viewer' says 'More than 12 positions: the first and last six and a count; more than 2000 positions ... the two ends ... and the count, with a sentence' and records no choice to print the count unshortened. The other P5-A2 entries say nothing on this either: '2.53', 'remaining findings (5 to 9)' (which adds 'a long number in the table view'), 'Download data'. DECISIONS.md 'MERGE: P5 stage 5.2' and 'MERGE: P5 stages 5.2 and 5.3 repaired after review' are silent too, and so are the 'Known and decided' list of P5-LENS-INSTRUCTIONS.md and build-plan/reports/orchestrator/phase5/*.json. Precedent: decisions/RT-FIX-P3-export-long.md 'T5's long dimension (SPEC 4.0 Long numbers)' (P3-RT-03-03, confirmed and fixed). There a count, the dimension, was read as a 'value' under 4.0 and shortened, which goes against a reading of 'value' as 'value on a node' only. Gate report reports/gate-G5.md, read from the report commit 28fa75a (parent 006f50d): line 5 names the gate commit 006f50d9f9b4843d37b4bfd3e75b0c051cc0ff39 and lists no open item on T12 long numbers. No reports/merge-P5-redteam-round*.md exists on disk. The oracle (lie_games.string_through) fixes only the line, whose length mu_i+1 the build computes. It has nothing on display, so I ran no oracle call. Note for the owner: the reproducer asserts the exact phrase '1.2345... x 10^19 (20 digits)'. RT-03 section 6 does not treat typography beyond what 4.0 fixes as the standard, but the cause, digits printed in full past 12, does not depend on the phrase.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed: 4.0 'Long numbers' has no qualifying clause, and the build shows a 20-digit value in full. R2 failed: 'A value of more than 12 digits' is not limited to node values, and the confirmed T5 dimension precedent (RT-FIX-P3-export-long) read a count as such a value. R3 failed: T12 is phase 5 and the gate is G5. R4 failed: the oracle defines only the line, whose length the build computes correctly, and says nothing on display. R5 failed: the 4.0 [D] text requires shortening, so this is a departure from the text, and no fragment or MERGE entry records the unshortened count. R6 failed: there is no open item in gate-G5.md, no earlier phase 5 round report, and no regression test. A stated behaviour shown wrong is major under RED-TEAM-COMMON 4, as claimed.
